name: Subdomain Takeover Scan
description: Sub-workflow: scans a lane of root domains one after another for subdomain takeovers, records new findings and alerts Discord. Started by Subdomain Takeover Monitor, max 3 lanes.

parameters.command:
=D='{{ $json.domain }}'
case "$D" in ''|*[!a-z0-9.-]*) echo '{"error":"invalid domain"}'; exit 1;; esac
OUT="/opt/loot/takeover/$D/$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
subfinder -d "$D" -silent -o "$OUT/subdomains.txt" >/dev/null 2>"$OUT/subfinder.log"
touch "$OUT/subdomains.txt"
dnsx -l "$OUT/subdomains.txt" -silent -cname -resp -json -o "$OUT/cnames.jsonl" >/dev/null 2>"$OUT/dnsx.log"
touch "$OUT/cnames.jsonl"
jq -r 'select(.cname) | .host' "$OUT/cnames.jsonl" | sort -u > "$OUT/cname-hosts.txt"
touch "$OUT/nuclei.jsonl"
if [ -s "$OUT/cname-hosts.txt" ]; then nuclei -l "$OUT/cname-hosts.txt" -tags takeover -jsonl -silent -nc -duc -rl 25 -o "$OUT/nuclei.jsonl" >/dev/null 2>"$OUT/nuclei.log"; fi
jq -nc --arg d "$D" --arg out "$OUT" --argjson subs "$(wc -l < "$OUT/subdomains.txt")" --slurpfile c "$OUT/cnames.jsonl" --slurpfile f "$OUT/nuclei.jsonl" '{domain: $d, output: $out, subdomains: $subs, cname_hosts: ($c | length), cnames: ($c | map({key: .host, value: (.cname | join(","))}) | from_entries), findings: ($f | map({host: .host, matched: ."matched-at", template: ."template-id", name: .info.name, severity: .info.severity}))}'
